scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && caffeinate -i npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d --build && echo "FreeStream: http://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0):${PORT:-8080}  Prowlarr: http://localhost:9696"
